{{Quote|This facility is crude, but it should be adequate to freeze Skywalker for his journey to the Emperor.|Darth Vader|<ref name="SWTESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Carbon-freezing chambers''' were [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas freezing technology used in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|freeze carbon]]. "Vacuums" located on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] took in tibanna gas from the depths of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and released it into the chambers to be frozen for more convenient transportation. While the gas is suspended inside the chamber, liquid [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] was applied, which cooled around the gas, freezing it.

==Description==
[[File:CarbonFreezeControls-TC.png|thumb|left|200px|The controls of a carbon-freezing chamber]]
Freezing chambers were also sometimes used to seal living beings&mdash;though one miscalculation could lead to death. This process required molten carbonite to be released into the chamber which was then flash frozen; a resulting blast of air, soon revealing a solidified encasement.<ref name="CCGfroze">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Frozen Assets}}</ref> The process could induce [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]] after being released, as was the case with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="SWTESB" /> The [[Alderaanian Medical Association]] also established that inhaling carbon-freezing smoke was a health risk.<ref name="CCGsmoke">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Smoke Screen}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Bounty_Collection_by_nash_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vader and Fett overlooking the freezing of Han Solo in carbonite]]
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used a carbon-freezing chamber to encase himself, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], his master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], so they might infiltrate the planets [[Gwori]]<ref name="TCW-SoD">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref> and [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref> undetected during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Darth Vader used the carbon-freezing chamber on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to encase [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in carbonite. The frozen Solo was given to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to deliver to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] for a bounty. The chamber was then reset, as Vader intended to encase [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in carbonite in order to transport him to the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] without resistance.<ref name="SWTESB" />

The freezing of sentient beings was once used by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] as a form of [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="TOTJ">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref>

One of the most popular and prominent models was the [[class three carbon-freezing chamber]] produced by [[Figg & Associates]].
